not_authenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
csrf_invalid: Your session check failed. Reload the page and try again.
origin_not_allowed: This request came from an origin that is not allowed.
reauth_required: For safety, this needs a sign-in from the last 10 minutes. Sign in again, then repeat the action.
forbidden: You are not allowed to do that.
pending_approval: Your account is waiting for an owner to approve it.
access_disabled: Your access was turned off by an administrator. Ask the person who runs this server to restore it.
method_not_allowed: The server does not accept that kind of request.
unsupported_media_type: The request was not in a format the server accepts. Reload the page and try again.
malformed_request: The request was not understood. Reload the page and try again.
validation_failed: Some of the information is not valid. Check it and try again.
rate_limited: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
rate_limited_wait: Too many requests. Try again in {{retry_after_s}} seconds.
token_store_unavailable: The token store is unavailable right now. Nothing was saved. Try again later.
internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
token_invalid_format: That does not look like a Canvas access token. Copy the whole token and try again.
token_rejected: Canvas rejected that token. Check that it is correct, has not expired and was not deleted.
token_unreadable: The stored token could not be read. Add a new token instead.
canvas_unavailable: Could not reach Canvas to check the token. Try again in a moment.
identity_change_required: This token belongs to a different Canvas user than the one enrolled. Confirm to replace it.
recheck_not_allowed: An administrator marked this token invalid, so it cannot be re-checked. Add a new token instead.
school_invalid: That school address is not valid.
school_not_offered: This server does not offer that school.
school_not_in_directory: That school is not in the school directory.
school_unresolvable: Could not find that school's Canvas server.
school_address_blocked: That school's address is not allowed.
school_selection_unverified: Pick the school from the search results again.
directory_unavailable: The school directory is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
write_tool_not_allowed: This server does not allow one of those tools, so nothing was saved.
write_tools_unavailable: Your write-tool settings cannot be read right now. Try again later.
last_owner: That would leave the server without an active owner.
cannot_disable_self: You cannot disable your own account.
state_invalid: That sign-in attempt expired or was not started here. Please start again.
provider_error: The sign-in provider could not complete the request. Please try again.
sign_in_incomplete: The sign-in response was incomplete. Please try again.
sign_in_unverified: The sign-in could not be verified. Please try again.
wrong_tenant: That account does not belong to the directory this server allows.
wrong_client: The sign-in was issued for a different application. Please start again.
bad_subject: The sign-in did not identify an account. Please try again.
bad_roles: The roles on that account are not valid for this server.
access_denied: Sign-in was denied. This account is not allowed to use this server.
signups_paused: New sign-ups are paused. Existing accounts can still sign in.
network_error: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
timeout: The server took too long to answer. Try again.
